segments.text: How old were you when you found out
that if you add Greek yogurt with a little cocoa powder
and honey, then whisk completely smooth,
you can turn it into creamy chocolate cheesecake bites,
crack in one egg, and mix everything together
until it turns into a creamy chocolate filling.
Pour it into a small grease baking dish,
bake it at 325 for about 25 minutes.
You end up with creamy chocolate cheesecake bites
that not only taste like something you would get
from a bakery, but are packed with protein
and made without all the refined sugar
you would normally find in cheesecake.
No refined sugar, low effort, high protein.
I have recipes like this
for every sweet treat you can think of.
